series.name: Human / The moment
series.description: The person and the interruption come first.

frames.headline: Heartburn Keeping You Up?
frames.subline: Get a clearer next step tonight.
frames.scene: A woman awake on the edge of her bed, with her partner asleep behind her.
frames.shortJob: Heartburn interrupts the night. Find one practical next step.
frames.jtbd: Interrupted sleep → understand evening context → one step

ui.title: Coach
ui.label: AI explanation · Example
ui.question: Why is my heartburn worse at night?
ui.explanation: After a meal, this interval may help with nighttime reflux symptoms.

frames.rationale: An interrupted night makes recurring heartburn personal and immediate. The meal-to-lying-down interval is a practical example, not a promise of relief.
frames.generationMethod: Built-in ImageGen photograph + deterministic HTML/CSS interface and composition

frames.headline: What Can I Eat With Reflux?
frames.subline: Check the menu before you order.
frames.scene: A woman considers an open menu before ordering in a warmly lit restaurant.
frames.shortJob: Choose an order with a specific adjustment in mind.
frames.jtbd: Restaurant uncertainty → review one dish → adjust the order

ui.title: Menu review
ui.label: AI meal guidance · Example
ui.focus: Ask for sauce on the side.
ui.explanation: Citrus and rich sauces can bother some people. Your own response may differ.

frames.rationale: The choice happens before ordering. Grilled salmon with lemon butter sauce becomes one explainable adjustment. The dish is not labelled safe and no individual trigger is predicted.
frames.generationMethod: Built-in ImageGen photograph + deterministic HTML/CSS interface and composition

frames.headline: Reflux Tests. What Do They Mean?
frames.scene: A woman studies a printed report at home in soft daylight.
frames.shortJob: Turn an unfamiliar reflux-test term into plain English.
frames.jtbd: Unfamiliar test report → understand one metric

ui.title: Report review
ui.label: AI explanation · Example
ui.focus: Time with acid in your esophagus.
ui.explanation: AET measures the percentage of time at pH below 4. Your clinician interprets it in context.

frames.rationale: The same synthetic acid exposure time of 7.2% appears on paper and in the interface. The example explains the metric without a diagnosis or threshold verdict. Third position is a creative hypothesis that broadens value beyond food and tracking.
frames.generationMethod: Built-in ImageGen photograph + deterministic HTML/CSS interface and composition
